decisions.reading: Latter-half melody is B5,A5,G#5,F#5 in eighths. Separate down-stem sixteenths are G#5,A4,F#5,A4,E5,A4,D5,A4. The two different heads on the main attacks belong to different voices, not an eighth chord with both notes.

Upper eight eighths E5,D5,C#5,B4,A4,C#5,B4,G#4. Independent lower upper-staff line is sixteen sixteenths C#5,F#4,B4,F#4,E4,F#4,D4,F#4,C#4,E4,C#5,E4,D4,E4,G#4,E4. At5/2 C#5 and7/2 G#4 have both up and down stems: retain both voice durations at the shared printed pitch; do not collapse to one sixteenth or one eighth. Each melody beam spans four eighths; each figuration beam spans four sixteenths.

Upper melody plus moving inner quarter line plus sustained E4 half at2 are three independent durations. A4->G#4 is a slur, not tie. Do not discard the E4 half or merge quarters into dotted-quarter melody.

Melody/inner half-chord are independently sustained in each staff. Upper tiny C#5 before E5 is ornament; measured E5 at3 lasts3/4, D5 at15/4 lasts1/4. Retain small note provisionally as grace; slash and performance theft remain precise final-review questions. No tuplet is printed.

P026 bass E2/D3 at2 and P027 A2/C#3 at0 are different pitches, so the two connecting curves are slurs. P027 A2 whole and C#3 quarter are independent. Upper P026 has E4 half then eighth melody, plus quarter rest0,A3/C#4 quarter1,G#3/B3 half2 in independent voice.
